basics.summary: I am a M.Sc. graduate interested in conducting research across wide spectrum of knowledge

location.address: Azim Premji University,Survey No. 66, Burugunte Village, Bikkanahalli Main Road, Sarjapura

work.name: Azim Premji University
work.summary: I work as a laboratory assistant and teaching assistant in physics courses working closely with undergraduate students on their reserach projects. I also actively conduct research in effective field theories and probing SMEFT operator effects in diboson channel.

volunteer.organization: Summer School for Women in Physics; Jointly organized by ICTS-TIFR & Azim Premji University
volunteer.summary: Facilitated a theoretical and demonstration session on "Demonstrating chaos with double pendulum and magnetic pendulum systems". Facilitated laboratorys essions for 53 undergradute students participating from all over India.

highlights: I completed my M.Sc. Physics degree here with a thesis in Experimental High Energy Physics group under the guidance of Prof. Saurabh Sandilya. I worked on Muon Scattering Tomography technique for non-destructive testing of materials with high and moderate atomic numbers.

I completed my B.Sc. Physics degree with a thesis in theoretical particle physics under the guidance of Prof. K. Sridhar. I worked on a review of CP violation in K and B meson systems and the study of strangeness oscillations.
